data.title: Ross Tucker
data.description: American football player and sports broadcaster (born 1979)
data.extract: Ross Finch Tucker is an American former professional football guard and current Emmy nominated sports broadcaster. Tucker was an All-Ivy League offensive lineman at Princeton University and then played seven seasons in the National Football League (NFL). Tucker retired as a player after suffering a neck injury during the 2007 season. He works for CBS Sports, the Philadelphia Eagles, Westwood One, Audacy, and hosts the Ross Tucker Football Podcast on the DraftKings Network.
